descriptor: Analytics cards for teams who read numbers fast

voice.summary: Reads like a sharp analyst who gets to the point: figure first, change second, caveat only if it matters. It never decorates a number it can simply state.
dos: State the value, then the delta, then the period
Use plain verbs like up, down and flat
Say what changed, not what it means for destiny
donts: Avoid vanity metrics framed as wins
Never hide a drop in soft wording

taglines: See the tide, not just the wave
boilerplate: Tidemark is an analytics tool that shows the key numbers a team needs as sparkline cards, with clear deltas and accessible data tables behind every chart.

microcopy.error: Could not load this metric. Try again shortly.
microcopy.empty: No data for this period yet.

logo.note: Rising bars give an instant, neutral read of a metric, like a tide line on a pier.
